This biography is preserved from the original archive.
 
 

Notable Accomplishments

May 2015: Taiwanese folk song 點仔膠 (for large orchestra) performed by Diamond Bar High School Symphonic Orchestra at Diamond High School Performing Arts Theater

March 2014: 點仔膠 (for strings orchestra) performed by Chaparral Middle School 8th Grade Sinfonia String Orchestra

March 2014: Commissioned by 財團法人國際沛思文教基金會 to compose children's song 地球的花園

February 2013: 在那遙遠的地方 (for strings orchestra) performed by Diamond Bar High School Symphonic Orchestra at San Gabriel Mission Playhouse

Yamaha certification: Piano Level 3, Electronic Keyboard Level 3, Music Theory Level 3 (1980-1986)

 I-Chunn Lee

南加大音樂學院 (USC Thornton School of Music), Los Angeles

(1997)
